title: Daily Workout · November 16
note: Monday · approximately 50 minutes prescribed: six established opening stretches (6 min), 35-minute incline treadmill walk, and supported upper-body strength (9 min). Posture rest today after Sunday practice. Recent report: completed full incline treadmill session in Topo Phantom 4 Wide without foot tingling, overheating, or pain during exercise, but intermittent sharp localized lower-right lumbar pain occurs later with right-foot weight bearing and disappears on unloading; user reports it may ease during warm-up. Do not treat warming up or Aleve relief as clearance to exercise through sharp pain. Begin with easy walking and only progress to prescribed 3% steady / 2%-4% intervals if pain-free throughout; stop for sharp back pain, radiating symptoms, weakness, or tingling. Avoid jogging, heavy yard work, forced lumbar extension and painful movements; seek clinician/PT assessment for recurrent sharp weight-bearing pain. Do not infer completed repetitions or weights. Topo Phantom 4 Wide is preferred based on one successful test, not proven long-term tolerance. Preserve six stretches; skip plow pose unless medically cleared (reference-only photo).

items.name: Single lean-back quad stretch
items.detail: 1 min · gently alternate sides within the minute
items.instructions: Seated on floor, one leg straight, other foot beside buttock; lean back with arm support only if comfortable. Skip if it provokes lumbar or knee pain. Use existing StretchCoach image registry entry.

items.name: Butterfly stretch
items.instructions: Soles together, sit upright, do not force knees down. One 60-second hold, not separate left/right holds.

items.name: Seated spinal twist
items.instructions: Use comfortable, controlled motion. Do not force rotation or continue if it provokes sharp back pain.

items.name: Plow pose with feet suspended
items.detail: 1 min timer · only if specifically cleared
items.instructions: Straight legs with feet suspended, not touching floor. Advanced neck/spine-loading inversion; do not perform without clearance for current lumbar symptoms. Existing photograph showing floor contact is reference-only.

items.name: Arm circles
items.instructions: Gentle circles, comfortable range; timing is provisional pending confirmation of original prescribed duration.

items.name: Overhead triceps stretch
items.instructions: Gentle overhead stretch without forcing the shoulder or arching the back; timing is provisional pending confirmation of original prescribed duration.

items.name: Warm-up walk
items.instructions: Start easy in Topo Athletic Phantom 4 Wide (men's 10.5W), previously comfortable during full treadmill workout. Check right-sided low-back symptoms and foot comfort. If sharp pain is present, do not push through it expecting warm-up to remove it; stop or switch to a comfortable non-provocative activity.

items.name: Steady brisk walk
items.instructions: Maintain fixed 3% incline only if fully comfortable and pain-free after warm-up. Keep natural stride; reduce intensity or stop if sharp lower-right back pain appears. No jogging.

items.name: Incline walking intervals
items.detail: 15 min · 3.6–4.2 mph · alternate 2% and 4% incline every 3 min
items.instructions: Three-minute blocks at 2%, 4%, 2%, 4%, 2%. Walking only, up to 4.2 mph if comfortable. Do not force prescribed speed or incline if right-sided back pain recurs; stop for sharp pain, tingling or radiating symptoms.

items.name: Cool-down walk
items.instructions: Easy pace, 0% incline. Note any pain during walking and later in the day, particularly sharp lower-right lumbar pain with right-foot loading.

items.name: Dumbbell bench press
items.instructions: Flat bench, feet supported on floor, comfortable light dumbbells; keep spine neutral and avoid exaggerated arching or leg drive. Use matching bench-press image registry entry. Skip if back pain occurs; do not assume actual weight lifted.

items.name: Supported dumbbell rows
items.instructions: One hand and knee supported on bench, neutral spine, light controlled rows. Avoid twisting or loading painful right side; skip if sharp lumbar pain.

items.name: Dumbbell biceps curls
items.instructions: Seated or standing with stable posture, elbows near sides, no swinging or leaning back. Skip if symptoms occur.
